name: Entity translation reminder
description: Displays a warning reminder message to editors when a translated content entity is updated, prompting them to update all of its translations; enabled per entity type and bundle.
project_description:
This lightweight module displays a reminder message when saving a translatable entity, prompting you to update all its translations if the entity has been translated.

 Features 
 The reminder message can be enabled per entity type and bundle which is configured to be translatable.

 Post-Installation 
 Go to /admin/config/regional/entity-translation-reminder to configure the entities for which you want to display the reminder.

 Additional Requirements 
 Drupal Core's "Content Translation" module (content_translation).
